titre: Family allowances in Réunion (from the 1st child)
resume: In Réunion, family allowances are paid from just one dependent child, with increases depending on the child's age. Who is eligible, how to apply, and what changes under shared residence.
aQuoiCaSert: Family allowances help families cover children's everyday expenses. In mainland France, they are only paid from 2 children. In the overseas departments, including Réunion, special rules apply: an allowance is paid from the first dependent child, with increases linked to the child's age. From 2 children, the mainland France rules apply again.
quiEstConcerne: Families living in Réunion with at least one dependent child under 20.
Separated parents whose child lives in shared residence.
Parents who do not yet receive benefits from the Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office).
aSavoir: Family with only one dependent child in the overseas departments (DOM): a family allowance is paid, increased from the child's 11th birthday, then raised again from age 16 (Cnaf, network letter LR-2026-051; article D. 755-5 of the code de la sécurité sociale, the Social Security Code).

From 2 children, the mainland France rules apply. Since March 1, 2026, the age-related increase is paid at 18 instead of 14 for children born on or after March 1, 2012 (the eldest in a family of 2 children is not eligible for it).
For 2 children, the basic amount ranges from €38.07 to €152.25 per month depending on household income (national scale, service-public.gouv.fr).
In the overseas departments, the complément familial (family supplement) has different conditions and a different amount from mainland France (service-public.gouv.fr refers to the Caf website).
In the overseas departments, the basic allowance of the Paje (prestation d'accueil du jeune enfant, early childhood benefit) cannot be combined with family allowances paid for one dependent child.

Shared residence: parents can designate a single beneficiary or split the family allowances in half (cerfa n° 14000). The choice applies for at least 1 year, unless the child's residence changes. If the parents disagree, each parent automatically receives a share.

Only family allowances are split (and the CMG, complément de libre choix du mode de garde or childcare supplement, which each parent can receive depending on their situation since December 1, 2025). Paje, complément familial, housing benefits, ARS, ASF and AEEH go in full to the designated parent.

documents.libelle: ID or residence permit of each parent
documents.detail: Valid copy, requested with your first application to the Caf.

documents.libelle: Family record book (livret de famille) or birth certificate of each child
documents.detail: Copy. Certificate free online or from the town hall (mairie) of the place of birth.

documents.libelle: RIB (bank details slip) of the parent receiving the benefits

documents.detail: Copy, downloadable on impots.gouv.fr. Your income is used in the calculation.
Recent copy (bill, rent receipt or certificate of accommodation).

documents.libelle: Judgment or agreement setting shared residence
documents.detail: Copy, to attach to the split form if shared residence was set by the judge or by an agreement.

documents.libelle: Form cerfa n° 14000, declaration in case of shared residence
documents.detail: Signed by both parents if you agree. Keep a copy.

etapes.titre: Register with the Caf if you have not already
etapes.detail: Apply for benefits on caf.fr. If you already receive Caf benefits, simply declare the child's birth or arrival.
Children correctly declared, income up to date, RIB, correct address, family situation (couple, separated, single parent). If you have separated, give the actual date.

etapes.titre: Shared residence: choose a split or a single beneficiary
etapes.detail: Fill in form cerfa n° 14000 together and send it to the Caf, with the judge's decision or the agreement if you have one.
View the details of your payments in your "Mon Compte" account and use the Caf simulator to check the amount.

ou.detail: Online procedures in your Mon Compte account; reception desks across the island.

actions.titre: Report any change in family situation to the Caf
Child turns 11: check the allowance increase (only child)

aConfirmer: To be confirmed with the Caf de La Réunion: the 2026 monthly amount of the allowance for a single child and of its increases at ages 11 and 16, not published in the national pages consulted. Use the Caf simulator.

To be confirmed with the Caf de La Réunion: the split under shared residence when the family has only one child (the national page, written for mainland France, states that a parent with only one child does not receive family allowances).

To be confirmed with the Caf de La Réunion: the conditions (children's age and number, income limits) and amount of the complément familial in the overseas departments, which could not be checked against an up-to-date official source.
To be confirmed locally: addresses and opening hours of the Caf de La Réunion reception desks (caf.fr site unreadable during the check).
